//: Type-check surface for the parts of the repo that are NOT built: scripts/ and test/.
They run as TypeScript directly (Node 22+ strips types), so nothing compiles them and
without this file a type error in a script or a test is invisible until it runs — which
is exactly the case that never shows up on the happy path. `pnpm typecheck:scripts`
`noEmit` because there is nothing to build: Node executes the sources. `allowImportingTsExtensions`
lets them import `./x.ts`, which is what Node needs and what the sources already use.
